subject.title: feat: let agents remember across private conversations

question: Should OpenClaw accept this new default-off per-agent `rememberAcrossConversations` config/API surface for same-agent private Active Memory recall once conflicts and docs metadata are repaired?
rationale: The implementation uses the intended memory seams, but it creates a durable config option, plugin context contract, and privacy-sensitive transcript recall authorization path that automation should not approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept After Repair
options.body: Resolve the merge conflict and stale docs map, keep the default-off same-agent-private boundary, and merge after maintainer product/security review confirms the new surface is desired.

options.title: Narrow The Surface
options.body: Keep the recall behavior experimental or internal until the config and plugin API contract are explicitly narrowed, documented, and upgrade-tested.

options.title: Defer The Feature
options.body: Leave https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99611 open and pause this PR if maintainers are not ready to add cross-conversation recall mode yet.

recommendation.title: Accept After Repair
recommendation.body: Resolve the merge conflict and stale docs map, keep the default-off same-agent-private boundary, and merge after maintainer product/security review confirms the new surface is desired.

likelyOwner.reason: davemorin owns the canonical request and all current implementation commits, so he is best positioned to answer the product/API intent question and repair the branch.
